reasons.claim: Notification is a 0.61 ha regeneration felling (Föryngringsavverkning), status notified; no completed felling overlaps the polygon (0%).

One eligible species within 250 m: Ramaria safraniolens (VU, site-bound fungus, forest-associated), with felling-related threats (lack of continuity forest, lack of large/old trees, ground disturbance in forestry). Record from 2025, 235 m from the edge, uncertainty 10 m.
Two NT site-bound forest fungi are also recorded within 250 m (Artomyces pyxidatus at 118 m, Sarcodon imbricatus at 207 m, both 2025). They are supporting evidence, below the 3-species NT threshold.
Effort is adequate (253 records within 1000 m vs county median 42), so the records reflect real recording rather than a gap.

uncertainties: All 9 records within 250 m come from a single observation day, so they may reflect one survey visit.
The VU record lies 235 m away, near the edge of the 250 m ring; it may not reflect conditions in the polygon.
Records are 2025 and may predate the notification.
not_established: That any red-listed species occupies the felling polygon itself.
That felling would harm these species.
Absence of species inside the polygon: no records inside, but near-site effort there is low (0 records, median 0).
next_action: Have an ecologist review the stand and the surrounding area for habitat of Ramaria safraniolens and the NT fungi, using the GBIF records, before felling starts. Consider a field check inside the polygon, since it has no records of its own.
